⚠️TRAFFIC NOTICE⚠️ 
Funeral Procession Traffic Advisory – Assistant Chief Walt Melnyk

Today is the service for Bryan Police Department Assistant Chief Walt Melnyk at Grace Bible Church – Creekside in College Station.

Start Time: Approximately 11:00 a.m.
Conclusion: Around 12:00 p.m.

Following the service, the funeral procession will travel:

Williams Creek Dr to William D. Fitch Pkwy

William D. Fitch Pkwy to Wellborn Rd

Wellborn Rd to Harvey Mitchell Pkwy

Harvey Mitchell Pkwy to Raymond Stotzer Pkwy

Raymond Stotzer Pkwy to the Aggie Field of Honor

Traffic Impact
Community members should expect significant traffic delays along the route during the lunchtime hours. Officers will be managing intersections and traffic flow to ensure a safe and uninterrupted procession.

Please plan alternate routes if traveling in the area.

Those wishing to pay their respects to Assistant Chief Melnyk are kindly asked not to park along the roadway, as this may disrupt the flow of the procession and create safety hazards.
